title: Finite type over a Noetherian ring is finite presentation
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $S$ an $R$-algebra of finite type ($S\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/\mathfrak a$ for some $n$ and some ideal $\mathfrak a$). Then $S$ is of finite presentation over $R$ ($\mathfrak a$ can be taken finitely generated).
